owner: providers openai_chat_completions usage.cost parse to the provider_response and provider_turn_duration events
synthetic_source: Every usage object and cost token in fixtures/events.json is hand-authored for Issue #947; none is copied from a provider response, a benchmark task, a grader input, an expected answer, generated code, or a run record. The amount 0.012345 matches the value the S-175a host check sent to a local fake HTTP stand-in; nothing else is taken from that record.
raw_cost_tokens: Each case's cost_token is raw JSON text that the test appends to the usage object of the response body as written, so 1e-400 and 1.00000000000000001 reach the client unrounded; reading the fixture as JSON never touches them.
event_type: provider_billed_cost_usd is a JSON string holding the exact decimal text of the usage.cost number token the provider sent (for example "0.012345", "1e-400", "0"), never a JSON number; an aggregator parses it as a decimal, never as a float.
base_events: fixtures/events.json base_events holds, for each case and for the executor and planner paths, the provider_response and provider_turn_duration lines that commit base_sha wrote when src/providers/lm_studio.rs billed_cost_telemetry_tests replayed the case from a loopback OpenAI-compatible stand-in with no credentials; only the wall-clock duration_ms value is replaced with 0. The cases listed in copied_from_absent were added after the capture and differ from synthetic-cost-absent only in usage.cost, which commit base_sha never reads, so their lines are copies of synthetic-cost-absent. An unreported amount must leave these lines byte-identical; a reported one may only add provider_billed_cost_usd.
aggregation: read provider_billed_cost_usd as a decimal string and count it once per turn; provider_response and provider_turn_duration of one turn carry the same amount and are never added together
